_note: KooSlurm(smart-twin-cluster) 평문 응답. dry_run_* 는 게이트웨이 실호출(앞머리만, 내부 주소 제외), error_real 은 MCP 프로세스 내 실호출, submit_ok·submit_parse_fail 은 소스(smarttwin_submit 반환문)에서 옮김.
dry_run_fullangle:
[DRY-RUN] 제출 계획 (실제 제출은 dry_run=False)
[fullangle_drop] template=smarttwin-fullangle-drop
model: /data/templates/MinimumModel.k (0.0MB → MinimumModel.k)
scenario: base=프리셋 26direction + overrides 병합
slurm_overrides: (없음)  job_name: procedure-seed-drop-dryrun
--- 드라이버 잡 #SBATCH (backend preview) ---
#SBATCH --job-name=procedure-seed-drop-dryrun
#SBATCH --time=167:00:00
dry_run_impact:
[DRY-RUN] 제출 계획 (실제 제출은 dry_run=False)
[partial_impact] template=smarttwin-partial-impact
model: /data/templates/MinimumModel.k (0.0MB → MinimumModel.k)
scenario: base=기본격자(5x5) + overrides 병합
slurm_overrides: (없음)  job_name: procedure-seed-impact-dryrun
--- 드라이버 잡 #SBATCH (backend preview) ---
#SBATCH --job-name=procedure-seed-impact-dryrun
#SBATCH --time=167:00:00
error_real: error: sim_type 은 fullangle_drop | partial_impact 중 하나여야 합니다.
submit_ok:
✅ 제출 완료 — job_id=12345
[fullangle_drop] template=smarttwin-fullangle-drop
script: /data/scripts/12345.sh
결과 폴더: /data/single/<사용자>/procedure-seed-drop_12345/ (드라이버 잡 완료 후)
submit_parse_fail: 제출 응답 파싱 실패(원문): <html>502 Bad Gateway</html>
submit_http_fail: error: 제출 실패(status=500): Internal Server Error
